label: common_0290_head_teacher_01
text: Excellent. It seems everyone is here.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_02
text: Well then, it’s time that I explained your\nindependent study assignment.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_03
text: As usual, the theme will be “A Treasure Hunt”![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_04
text: I ask each of you to set out and travel the world\nin search of your own treasure.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_05
text: You have all learned much within the walls of our\nfine academy...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_06
text: But now it is time to turn your eyes upon the\nwider world and deepen your understanding.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_07
text: Explore Paldea’s abundant nature, soak in its\nrich culture...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_08
text: discover the Pokémon that live here...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_09
text: and get to know the people, too.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_10
text: Where will you travel? Who will you meet?\nAnd what will you achieve?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_11
text: Of course, your Pokémon partners will be there\nto help you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_14
text: share each other’s thoughts and feelings...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_15
text: and find something you might always treasure![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_16
text: I look forward to welcoming you all back after\nyour independent study...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_17
text: when you return to us as fine young Trainers![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0290_head_teacher_18
text: Let the Treasure Hunt begin! Onward![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
